description: Reviewed untranslated-text ratchet after clearing the shared UI, reports/export and backend-message findings that the previous review had merely re-ceilinged. The company-access, remote-support authorization, rollout and screen-feed transport messages, the export-attachment and container report errors, and the shared UI company/remote-control and page/row action labels are now translated in the Phase 3, Phase 6 and Phase 7 registries, so those three modules drop to zero actionable. The one remaining shared UI finding was a detector false positive - the generic call requestJson<T>() reads as JSX text - and is recorded as a technical identifier rather than translated. Ceilings are tightened to the observed counts so the gains cannot be given back; the ratchet remains enforced, unclassified findings remain forbidden, and no stock item names, stock group names, business names, codes, references, dates, or amounts are translated by this update.
